configuration.title: BYK
byk.priorityPaths.description: Highest priority: directories to search for `byk` / `byk.exe`, in array order, first hit wins. Absolute paths only; `~` is expanded; missing directories are skipped silently
byk.secondarySource.description: Second priority: when none of the directories above hit, use the bundled byk or the system one. The other becomes the final fallback
byk.secondarySource.bundled.description: Bundled first — use the byk shipped with this extension (pinned version), falling back to PATH
byk.secondarySource.system.description: System first — use the byk found on PATH, falling back to the bundled one
